questions.question_en: What is the mole fraction of sodium (n moles) in a solution containing N moles of solvent?
questions.question_ar: ما الكسر المولي للصوديوم (عدد مولاته $n$) في محلول يحتوي على $N$ مول من المذيب؟
questions.explanation_en: Mole fraction is moles of the component divided by total moles. $$x_{\text{Na}} = \frac{n_{\text{Na}}}{n_{\text{total}}} = \frac{n}{n + N}$$
questions.explanation_ar: الكسر المولي = مولات المكوّن / مجموع المولات. $$x_{\text{Na}} = \frac{n_{\text{Na}}}{n_{\text{total}}} = \frac{n}{n + N}$$
questions.memorization_note: 1. الكسر المولي: $$x_i = \frac{n_i}{\sum_j n_j}$$ 2. الكسر الكتلي: $$w_i = \frac{m_i}{\sum_j m_j}$$ 3. المولات: $n = \frac{m}{M_w}$.

questions.question_en: What is the unit of mole fraction?
questions.question_ar: ما وحدة الكسر المولي؟
questions.explanation_en: It is a ratio of moles to moles, so the units cancel. $$x_i = \frac{\text{mol}}{\text{mol}} \;\Rightarrow\; \text{dimensionless}$$
questions.explanation_ar: هو نسبة مولات إلى مولات فتُلغى الوحدات ويكون بلا أبعاد. $$x_i = \frac{\text{mol}}{\text{mol}} \;\Rightarrow\; \text{dimensionless}$$
questions.memorization_note: 1. الكسر المولي: $$x_i = \frac{n_i}{\sum_j n_j}$$ 2. الكسر الكتلي: $$w_i = \frac{m_i}{\sum_j m_j}$$ 3. المولات: $n = \frac{m}{M_w}$.

questions.question_en: The mole fraction of sodium is 0.25 in a mixture with 9 mol of liquid $\text{CO}_2$. What is the mass fraction of sodium?
questions.question_ar: الكسر المولي للصوديوم $0.25$ في خليط يحتوي $9\text{ mol}$ من $\text{CO}_2$ السائل. ما الكسر الكتلي للصوديوم؟
questions.explanation_en: $$0.25 = \frac{n}{n+9} \Rightarrow n = 3\text{ mol Na}$$ $$m_{\text{Na}} = 3\times23 = 69\text{ g},\ m_{\text{CO}_2} = 9\times44 = 396\text{ g}$$ $$w_{\text{Na}} = \frac{69}{69+396} = 0.15$$
questions.explanation_ar: $$0.25 = \frac{n}{n+9} \Rightarrow n = 3\text{ mol Na}$$ $$m_{\text{Na}} = 3\times23 = 69\text{ g},\ m_{\text{CO}_2} = 9\times44 = 396\text{ g}$$ $$w_{\text{Na}} = \frac{69}{69+396} = 0.15$$

questions.question_en: A mixture of $\text{SO}_2$ and $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ has a mole fraction of $\text{SO}_2$ equal to 0.2. What is the mass ratio of sulfur to oxygen in the mixture?
questions.question_ar: خليط من $\text{SO}_2$ و $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ الكسر المولي لـ $\text{SO}_2$ فيه $0.2$. ما نسبة كتلة الكبريت إلى كتلة الأوكسجين في الخليط؟
questions.explanation_en: Basis: $x$ mol $\text{SO}_2$ and $y$ mol $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$; $\frac{x}{x+y}=0.2 \Rightarrow y = 4x$. $$m_S = 32(x+y) = 160x,\quad m_O = 16(2x + 4y) = 288x$$ $$\frac{m_S}{m_O} = \frac{160}{288} = 0.555$$
questions.explanation_ar: Basis: $x$ mol $\text{SO}_2$ and $y$ mol $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$; $\frac{x}{x+y}=0.2 \Rightarrow y = 4x$. $$m_S = 32(x+y) = 160x,\quad m_O = 16(2x + 4y) = 288x$$ $$\frac{m_S}{m_O} = \frac{160}{288} = 0.555$$

questions.question_en: A mixture of total mass 17 g contains 7 g of nitrogen, all present as the neutral compound of nitrogen and hydrogen. What is the mass fraction of that compound?
questions.question_ar: خليط كتلته الكلية $17\text{ g}$ يحتوي $7\text{ g}$ من النيتروجين موجودة كلها في المركب المتعادل المكوّن من النيتروجين والهيدروجين. ما الكسر الكتلي لذلك المركب؟
questions.explanation_en: The neutral N–H compound is $\text{NH}_3$ ($M_w = 17$). $$m_{\text{NH}_3} = 7\times\frac{17}{14} = 8.5\text{ g}\;\Rightarrow\; w = \frac{8.5}{17} = 0.5$$
questions.explanation_ar: The neutral N–H compound is $\text{NH}_3$ ($M_w = 17$). $$m_{\text{NH}_3} = 7\times\frac{17}{14} = 8.5\text{ g}\;\Rightarrow\; w = \frac{8.5}{17} = 0.5$$

questions.memorization_note: 1. الكسر المولي: $$x_i = \frac{n_i}{\sum_j n_j}$$ 2. الكسر الكتلي: $$w_i = \frac{m_i}{\sum_j m_j}$$ 3. المولات: $n = \frac{m}{M_w}$. 4. $\text{NaCl}=58.5,\ \text{CH}_4=16,\ \text{H}_2\text{O}=18$.

questions.question_en: Which of the following is NOT a unit of concentration?
questions.question_ar: أي مما يلي ليس وحدة للتركيز؟
questions.explanation_en: Concentration is amount (moles or mass) per unit volume (or a ratio like ppm). $\text{N/m}^3$ is force per volume (specific weight).
questions.explanation_ar: Concentration is amount (moles or mass) per unit volume (or a ratio like ppm). $\text{N/m}^3$ is force per volume (specific weight).
questions.memorization_note: 1. التركيز الكتلي: $C = \frac{m}{V}$ ($\text{kg/m}^3$). 2. التركيز المولي (المولارية): $$M = \frac{n}{V_{\text{L}}} = \frac{m/M_w}{V_{\text{L}}}$$ 3. $\text{ppm} = \frac{m_{\text{solute}}}{m_{\text{solution}}}\times10^6$. 4. قانون الخلط: $$M_{\text{mix}} = \frac{M_1V_1 + M_2V_2}{V_1 + V_2}$$

questions.question_en: A solution has a concentration of $4\text{ mol/m}^3$ of sodium. If the solution volume is $2\text{ m}^3$ (10 kg of solvent with density $5\text{ kg/m}^3$), how much sodium is present?
questions.question_ar: محلول تركيز الصوديوم فيه $4\text{ mol/m}^3$. إذا كان حجم المحلول $2\text{ m}^3$ ($10\text{ kg}$ مذيب كثافته $5\text{ kg/m}^3$) فكم كتلة الصوديوم؟
questions.explanation_en: $$V = \frac{10}{5} = 2\text{ m}^3,\quad n = C V = 4\times2 = 8\text{ mol},\quad m = 8\times23 = 184\text{ g}$$
questions.explanation_ar: $$V = \frac{10}{5} = 2\text{ m}^3,\quad n = C V = 4\times2 = 8\text{ mol},\quad m = 8\times23 = 184\text{ g}$$

questions.question_en: A solution of density $1\text{ g/cm}^3$ contains 98 g of $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ in 402 g of water. What is its molarity?
questions.question_ar: محلول كثافته $1\text{ g/cm}^3$ يحتوي $98\text{ g}$ من $\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$ في $402\text{ g}$ ماء. ما مولاريته؟
questions.explanation_en: $$n = \frac{98}{98} = 1\text{ mol},\quad V = \frac{500\text{ g}}{1\text{ g/cm}^3} = 500\text{ cm}^3 = 0.5\text{ L},\quad M = \frac{1}{0.5} = 2\text{ M}$$
questions.explanation_ar: $$n = \frac{98}{98} = 1\text{ mol},\quad V = \frac{500\text{ g}}{1\text{ g/cm}^3} = 500\text{ cm}^3 = 0.5\text{ L},\quad M = \frac{1}{0.5} = 2\text{ M}$$
